projects.name: DoctorGemma – LoRA Fine-Tuning of Gemma-3 4B
projects.description: LoRA fine-tuning study of Gemma-3 4B (4-bit, Unsloth, Hugging Face TRL SFTTrainer) on the HealthCareMagic-100k doctor-patient QA dataset, based on Atharva Taras's DoctorGemma-3 (Apache-2.0); my extensions are in progress. Reference run: training loss 5.93 → 3.01 over 30 steps (no held-out eval yet).

projects.name: IncluHub – Programme Workflow Dashboard
projects.description: Full-stack role-based dashboard for an inclusive creative-education programme. Admin, educator, student and external-member roles move teams through a 6-stage programme (onboarding to brand works), with portfolio approvals, studio scheduling and brand opportunities. Built with Next.js, React, Tailwind and Supabase (Postgres with row-level security, 32 tables), deployed on Vercel.

projects.name: NeuroFuse – Diffusion-Based MRI+CT Fusion for Brain Tumor Classification (IEEE ICCCMLA 2026)
projects.description: Team B.Tech project (5 students). CycleGAN synthesises CT from MRI; the Diff-IF diffusion model (DDIM sampling) fuses MRI + CT; PyTorch classifiers reach 98.2% (ConvNeXt-B) and 98.9% (ViT) accuracy, served per patient in a Streamlit app. Research software, not a clinical tool. Paper accepted (not yet published) at IEEE ICCCMLA 2026.

Built n8n + REST API pipelines unifying Meta Graph, WhatsApp and Ads APIs into one flow for ads, leads and follow-ups, and internal CRM tools that replaced 7–8 Google Sheets and lifted sales-team throughput 50%+.
